description: N-Quads escaping is exactly backslash, quote, n, r, t and lowercase u00xx for other C0 characters; every character at or above U+0020 is written as itself in UTF-8, so an astral character is never U-escaped. A plain literal carries an explicit xsd:string in N-Quads and none in Turtle.
